# Деловой Казахстан (DKNews.kz)

> > Kazakhstan's leading business news portal covering politics, economy, technology partnerships with China and Huawei, and national development.

Деловой Казахстан (Business Kazakhstan) provides comprehensive coverage of Kazakhstan's economic and political landscape, with special focus on China-Kazakhstan relations, technology initiatives including Huawei's 5G-A and AI deployments, and national policy developments under President Tokayev. The publication serves both Russian and Chinese-speaking audiences.

## Key Topics

- Kazakhstan (Казахстан/哈萨克斯坦)
- President Tokayev (Токаев)
- China-Kazakhstan relations (中国-哈萨克斯坦)
- Huawei (华为)
- 5G-A technology
- Belt and Road Initiative
- Artificial Intelligence in telecom
- MWC Shanghai 2024
- Electric vehicles
- Digital transformation
- Business and economy news
- Political developments
- Constitutional reform and referendum
- Tenge exchange rate
- Ерлан Карин (Presidential Administration)
